answer_1.quote: We introduce Reflective ASPect-based summarization (ReflectASP), a novel dataset ... and benchmark various zero-shot summarization approaches...
answer_1.outputs: Aspect‑based abstractive summaries of student reflections

answer_2.quote: We measure ROUGE F1s and BERTScore F1 ... we also report MC EXT and MC INPUT ... and GPT‑4 based evaluation results.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT‑4 based evaluation metrics: GPT‑4 Factuality Likert Scale Score (G), which uses GPT‑4 to score generations when provided a well‑defined rubric ... we also compute pairwise score differences (Pair ΔG) to determine Wins, Same, and Losses.

answer_4.quote: Using Amazon Mechanical Turk, we randomly selected 50 samples ... collected annotations on summaries generated by ten different systems. For each sample, three annotations were obtained (thus a total of 1500 annotations), with document‑level metrics (Relevance to Aspect and Consistency) reported as averages and sentence‑level annotations determined by majority vote.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators read the aspect‑based summary and answered rating questions for Relevance to Aspect (3‑point scale), Consistency (3‑point scale), and sentence‑level aspect‑based factuality.
